discovery.hypothesis: Investigate only if Atlanta's defensive availability and New Orleans' expected backfield allocation support reduced rushing opportunity. The October 3 report lists Divine Deablo and Samson Ebukam as questionable with hamstring injuries; Ebukam reached full practice participation, while Deablo remained limited. Neither availability nor game-day limitations are resolved, so a healthy-defense adjustment is not yet defensible.
discovery.question: Will Deablo and Ebukam be active without meaningful restrictions, and does Kamara's expected carry allocation still support an under if either defender is absent or limited?
